name: Fluency-Based Aesthetic Interest
fact: Disfluent stimuli can enhance aesthetic attractiveness through interest when processed in a controlled, effortful style that reduces disfluency over time.
boundary: Occurs specifically when disfluent stimuli become more fluent through active processing efforts (disfluency reduction).

provenance.title: Aesthetic Pleasure versus Aesthetic Interest: The Two Routes to Aesthetic Liking
provenance.quote_or_locus: Stimulus fluency and interest, by contrast, are related through a process of disfluency reduction, such that disfluent stimuli that grow more fluent due to processing efforts become interesting
